description: This file defines the 'GenericHelperDAO' class, which implements data access object (DAO) operations for generic entity manipulation in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating, finding, updating, and deleting entities, as well as querying and metadata validation.

classes.name: GenericHelperDAO
classes.description: A DAO class for generic entity operations enabling creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and querying of entities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getHelperName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the helper provided during instantiation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new GenericValue entity in the database.

methods.name: createAll
methods.description: Inserts a list of GenericValues into the database.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Finds a GenericValue by its primary key.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Finds a GenericValue by its primary key, returning only selected fields.

methods.name: findAllByPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves multiple entities by their primary keys.

methods.name: removeByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Deletes a record identified by primary key.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Finds entities matching a condition, returning an iterator.

methods.name: findByMultiRelation
methods.description: Finds related entities through multiple relations.

methods.name: removeByCondition
methods.description: Removes entities based on a condition.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Updates an entity in the database.

methods.name: storeByCondition
methods.description: Batch updates entities matching a condition.

methods.name: checkDataSource
methods.description: Validates and optionally updates database schema to match entity definitions.
